beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The sky tears open over the final battlefield. Red light, black light, and a whole world holding its breath.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] The sky tears open over the final battlefield. Red light, black light, and a whole world holding its breath.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Asta! Wake up! Asta!
beats.spokenText: [shouting, desperate] Asta! Wake up! Asta!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Asta falls, and the world goes silent. Then church bells. Cold sheets. Small, trembling hands. Same bed, same church, same cracked ceiling.
beats.spokenText: [soft, disoriented] Asta falls, and the world goes silent. Then church bells. Cold sheets. Small, trembling hands. Same bed, same church, same cracked ceiling.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Asta was never supposed to have magic. He was supposed to wait fifteen years in the dirt for a miracle.
beats.spokenText: Asta was never supposed to have magic. He was supposed to wait fifteen years in the dirt for a miracle.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: What if he remembered everything? The Spade raid. The betrayals. Every name, every face, every grave.
beats.spokenText: What if he remembered everything? The Spade raid. The betrayals. Every name, every face, every grave.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: And the brother sealed inside the wall of Hage's tower. All of it, in the head of a six year old boy.
beats.spokenText: [whispering] And the brother sealed inside the wall of Hah-gay's tower. All of it, in the head of a six year old boy.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The wind in Hage comes down off the demon skull, and nobody ever thinks twice about it. Asta thinks about nothing else. He stands at the church fence, eyes closed, and feels the air lean.
beats.spokenText: The wind in Hah-gay comes down off the demon skull, and nobody ever thinks twice about it. Asta thinks about nothing else. He stands at the church fence, eyes closed, and feels the air lean.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Ki. The breath and the heartbeat of the world. A body with no magic can still learn to hear it.
beats.spokenText: Key. The breath and the heartbeat of the world. A body with no magic can still learn to hear it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The air shifts. Three seconds later, Yuno's gust slams the laundry line, and every sheet snaps.
beats.spokenText: The air shifts. Three seconds later, Yoo-no's gust slams the laundry line, and every sheet snaps.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: Hey. You looked at the sheets before my wind even moved. How?
beats.spokenText: Hey. You looked at the sheets before my wind even moved. How?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Heh. Lucky guess.
beats.spokenText: Heh. Lucky guess.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Yuno is six, and still a crybaby. Last time, Asta mocked him for it. This time, he hands him a handkerchief.
beats.spokenText: Yoo-no is six, and still a crybaby. Last time, Asta mocked him for it. This time, he hands him a handkerchief.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: I wasn't crying! It was the wind, okay?
beats.spokenText: [sniffling, defensive] I wasn't crying! It was the wind, okay?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Sure it was. Totally the wind.
beats.spokenText: Sure it was. Totally the wind.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: Why are you being nice to me? It's weird. What do you want?
beats.spokenText: Why are you being nice to me? It's weird. What do you want?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Call it an investment.
beats.spokenText: Call it an investment.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: It confuses everyone. The loudest kid in Hage has gone quiet, and he watches everything. Then Sister Lily crosses the yard, and an old habit wakes up on its own.
beats.spokenText: It confuses everyone. The loudest kid in Hah-gay has gone quiet, and he watches everything. Then Sister Lily crosses the yard, and an old habit wakes up on its own.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Sister Lily, marry me!
beats.spokenText: [deadpan] Sister Lily, marry me!

beats.speaker: SISTER_LILY
beats.captionText: Oh, Asta. You know the rule.
beats.spokenText: Oh, Asta. You know the rule.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He feels her weight shift a heartbeat early. And for the first time in history, Asta steps aside.
beats.spokenText: He feels her weight shift a heartbeat early. And for the first time in history, Asta steps aside.

beats.speaker: FATHER_ORSI
beats.captionText: It missed! Lily's fist missed! That's never happened!
beats.spokenText: [panicked, disbelieving] It missed! Lily's fist missed! That's never happened!

beats.speaker: SISTER_LILY
beats.captionText: Oh my. Asta, you're growing up so fast.
beats.spokenText: Oh my. Asta, you're growing up so fast.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: At seven, Asta asks Yuno for a blindfold, then tells him to throw everything he has. Wind blades. Pebbles. A gust meant to knock him flat. He slips between them like smoke.
beats.spokenText: At seven, Asta asks Yoo-no for a blindfold, then tells him to throw everything he has. Wind blades. Pebbles. A gust meant to knock him flat. He slips between them like smoke.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: How did you know?
beats.spokenText: [stunned] How did you know?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Throw harder. You breathe in right before you cast.
beats.spokenText: Throw harder. You breathe in right before you cast.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Yuno goes very still. He isn't used to being the one who's behind. And he hates how it feels.
beats.spokenText: Yoo-no goes very still. He isn't used to being the one who's behind. And he hates how it feels.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: Then I'll learn not to. I'll be Wizard King first, you'll see.
beats.spokenText: Then I'll learn not to. I'll be Wizard King first, you'll see.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Try it. I'm still beating you there, Yuno.
beats.spokenText: Try it. I'm still beating you there, Yoo-no.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Season after season, he trains the only thing nobody can take from him. And every night, he climbs to the roof and looks at the grimoire tower.
beats.spokenText: Season after season, he trains the only thing nobody can take from him. And every night, he climbs to the roof and looks at the grim-wahr tower.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Because he knows what is sleeping in its wall. And he knows exactly how long it has been waiting.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, ominous] Because he knows what is sleeping in its wall. And he knows exactly how long it has been waiting.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Age ten. Midnight. The grimoire tower is empty, and Asta knows which stone to press. He follows the draft, cold and thin, to a crack in the wall.
beats.spokenText: Age ten. Midnight. The grim-wahr tower is empty, and Asta knows which stone to press. He follows the draft, cold and thin, to a crack in the wall.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Behind the cracked stone lies a filthy, tattered book. Five leaves. He's waited four years to touch it.
beats.spokenText: Behind the cracked stone lies a filthy, tattered book. Five leaves. He's waited four years to touch it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: His fingers close on the cover, and the tower vanishes. Black water. No floor, no sky. Something vast turns over in the dark, and it's hungry.
beats.spokenText: [hushed, tense] His fingers close on the cover, and the tower vanishes. Black water. No floor, no sky. Something vast turns over in the dark, and it's hungry.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Chains of old black light hang from nowhere, and every single one of them is aimed at him.
beats.spokenText: Chains of old black light hang from nowhere, and every single one of them is aimed at him.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: A magicless brat, walking right into my mouth. How convenient.
beats.spokenText: [low, menacing] A magicless brat, walking right into my mouth. How convenient.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Devils hate humans. I hate you most. I'll be wearing you by morning.
beats.spokenText: Devils hate humans. I hate you most. I'll be wearing you by morning.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Asta doesn't raise a hand. He just looks up, the way you look at someone you've missed for years.
beats.spokenText: Asta doesn't raise a hand. He just looks up, the way you look at someone you've missed for years.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Why aren't you scared, boy?
beats.spokenText: Why aren't you scared, boy?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Your name is Liebe.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, certain] Your name is Lee-beh.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Who told you that? Nobody knows that name.
beats.spokenText: Who told you that? Nobody knows that name.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Your mother named you. Her name was Licita.
beats.spokenText: Your mother named you. Her name was Lee-chee-tah.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Don't. Don't say that name.
beats.spokenText: [low, shaking] Don't. Don't say that name.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Licita. She held you until the very end.
beats.spokenText: Lee-chee-tah. She held you until the very end.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: I said don't!
beats.spokenText: [snarling, breaking] I said don't!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The dark shudders. Claws that were closing stop, trembling, an inch from his face.
beats.spokenText: The dark shudders. Claws that were closing stop, trembling, an inch from his face.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: She died. She sealed me in this filth and died. What do you know?
beats.spokenText: [bitter, cracking] She died. She sealed me in this filth and died. What do you know?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: That she chose you. Every single time.
beats.spokenText: [soft] That she chose you. Every single time.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Nothing. For a long time, only the sound of something enormous trying not to breathe.
beats.spokenText: Nothing. For a long time, only the sound of something enormous trying not to breathe.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: She was my mother too.
beats.spokenText: [whispering] She was my mother too.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: No. That's not possible.
beats.spokenText: [small, hollow] No. That's not possible.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: She left me at a church door so I'd live.
beats.spokenText: She left me at a church door so I'd live.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Who are you?
beats.spokenText: [whispering] Who are you?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Your brother. And I'm late.
beats.spokenText: [tender] Your brother. And I'm late.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Last time, I was fifteen years late.
beats.spokenText: Last time, I was fifteen years late.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Last time? What does that mean?
beats.spokenText: Last time? What does that mean?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Later. First, let me sit down.
beats.spokenText: Later. First, let me sit down.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: What do you want from me?
beats.spokenText: What do you want from me?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Just to sit here a minute. With my brother.
beats.spokenText: Just to sit here a minute. With my brother.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Tch. You're the dumbest human I've ever met.
beats.spokenText: [gruff, choked up] Tch. You're the dumbest human I've ever met.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Probably. I've been told.
beats.spokenText: Probably. I've been told.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Outside, the dawn bell rolls over Hage. Asta climbs out of the tower with dust on his hands and no fear at all. Behind him, in the wall, a devil lies still. Not trapped. Waiting.
beats.spokenText: [warm, then ominous] Outside, the dawn bell rolls over Hah-gay. Asta climbs out of the tower with dust on his hands and no fear at all. Behind him, in the wall, a devil lies still. Not trapped. Waiting.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Five years. By day, Ki footwork until his legs shake. By night, he sits against the tower wall and talks. About bread. About Yuno. About the sky.
beats.spokenText: Five years. By day, Key footwork until his legs shake. By night, he sits against the tower wall and talks. About bread. About Yoo-no. About the sky.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Today Yuno tried to cut a tree. The tree won.
beats.spokenText: Today Yoo-no tried to cut a tree. The tree won.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: You're boring me to death, human. Bread? Seriously, bread?
beats.spokenText: You're boring me to death, human. Bread? Seriously, bread?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Then why do you keep answering?
beats.spokenText: Then why do you keep answering?

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: I'm stuck in a book. Echoes are all I get.
beats.spokenText: I'm stuck in a book. Echoes are all I get.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The book won't open before the ceremony. So Asta waits, again. But this time, he isn't waiting alone.
beats.spokenText: The book won't open before the ceremony. So Asta waits, again. But this time, he isn't waiting alone.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Make the contract. Master and servant. That's how it works.
beats.spokenText: Make the contract. Master and servant. That's how it works.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: No. Equals, or nothing.
beats.spokenText: No. Equals, or nothing.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Tch. Fine. Equals. Whatever. Like I care.
beats.spokenText: Tch. Fine. Equals. Whatever. Like I care.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Fifteen. The tower hall is packed with trembling children. Yuno steps forward, and a four-leaf grimoire answers him.
beats.spokenText: Fifteen. The tower hall is packed with trembling children. Yoo-no steps forward, and a four-leaf grim-wahr answers him.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Then it's Asta's turn. Nothing. No light, no book. Only laughter, rolling across the hall.
beats.spokenText: Then it's Asta's turn. Nothing. No light, no book. Only laughter, rolling across the hall.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: They're laughing at you. Doesn't that bother you?
beats.spokenText: They're laughing at you. Doesn't that bother you?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Not anymore. I know how this ends.
beats.spokenText: Not anymore. I know how this ends.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Exactly as before, down to the last giggle. And this time, Asta smiles. On the road home, Revchi steps out of the trees, chains hissing at his wrists. He wants Yuno's grimoire.
beats.spokenText: Exactly as before, down to the last giggle. And this time, Asta smiles. On the road home, Rev-chee steps out of the trees, chains hissing at his wrists. He wants Yoo-no's grim-wahr.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He doesn't notice the magicless boy who's already standing behind him. Nobody ever does.
beats.spokenText: He doesn't notice the magicless boy who's already standing behind him. Nobody ever does.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Revchi. Chain Magic. Thrown out of the Purple Orcas in disgrace.
beats.spokenText: Rev-chee. Chain Magic. Thrown out of the Purple Orcas in disgrace.

beats.speaker: REVCHI
beats.captionText: Magicless trash like you has no right to—
beats.spokenText: [sneering] Magicless trash like you has no right to—

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Skip it.
beats.spokenText: [bored, flat] Skip it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Behind them the tower groans. A crack tears up the wall, and the stone gives way. The five-leaf grimoire rips itself free and tears across the sky, straight for his hand.
beats.spokenText: Behind them the tower groans. A crack tears up the wall, and the stone gives way. The five-leaf grim-wahr rips itself free and tears across the sky, straight for his hand.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Hurry up, partner. I'm getting bored over here.
beats.spokenText: [grinning] Hurry up, partner. I'm getting bored over here.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Demon-Slayer Sword drops into his hand. One swing. Revchi's chains don't break. They simply stop existing.
beats.spokenText: [quiet awe] The Demon-Slayer Sword drops into his hand. One swing. Rev-chee's chains don't break. They simply stop existing.

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.captionText: Ha! Now that's what I'm talking about.
beats.spokenText: [grinning] Ha! Now that's what I'm talking about.

beats.speaker: REVCHI
beats.captionText: My chains! What did you do to my chains?
beats.spokenText: [panicked] My chains! What did you do to my chains?

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: You've been hiding something since we were six.
beats.spokenText: You've been hiding something since we were six.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Only a few things.
beats.spokenText: Only a few things.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: Fine. Keep your secrets. Just leave me an enemy next time.
beats.spokenText: Fine. Keep your secrets. Just leave me an enemy next time.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Then be faster, Yuno.
beats.spokenText: Then be faster, Yoo-no.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: Hmph. I was letting you have it.
beats.spokenText: [deadpan] Hmph. I was letting you have it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Royal Capital. Banners, towers, ten thousand voices. Every hopeful in the kingdom, packed into one arena.
beats.spokenText: The Royal Capital. Banners, towers, ten thousand voices. Every hopeful in the kingdom, packed into one arena.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: And across the field, a man in black, cigarette burning low. Yami Sukehiro. Alive. Asta's breath catches. He remembers losing that man, and now he's standing right there, yawning.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, restrained] And across the field, a man in black, cigarette burning low. Yah-mee Soo-keh-hee-roh. Alive. Asta's breath catches. He remembers losing that man, and now he's standing right there, yawning.

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.captionText: Kid. Why are you looking at me like I died?
beats.spokenText: [deadpan] Kid. Why are you looking at me like I died?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: No reason. Really.
beats.spokenText: No reason. Really.

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.captionText: Stop it. You're creeping me out, kid.
beats.spokenText: Stop it. You're creeping me out, kid.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Sorry. Long story.
beats.spokenText: Sorry. Long story.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: His match lasts one breath. Asta reads the swing, steps inside it, and ends it with one move.
beats.spokenText: His match lasts one breath. Asta reads the swing, steps inside it, and ends it with one move.

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.captionText: Not bad, brat. Where'd you learn that?
beats.spokenText: Not bad, brat. Where'd you learn that?

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: A very patient teacher.
beats.spokenText: A very patient teacher.

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.captionText: Tch. Whoever he is, he owes me a drink.
beats.spokenText: Tch. Whoever he is, he owes me a drink.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The arena goes silent. Then one hand goes up. Then another. Hands that never went up for him before.
beats.spokenText: The arena goes silent. Then one hand goes up. Then another. Hands that never went up for him before.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Noelle Silva. Last time, her water magic ran wild for months, and Asta watched her become the pride of her house. Today she's at the edge of the field, spilling water over her own boots.
beats.spokenText: No-ell Silva. Last time, her water magic ran wild for months, and Asta watched her become the pride of her house. Today she's at the edge of the field, spilling water over her own boots.

beats.speaker: NOELLE
beats.captionText: Eyes off, commoner. My magic is just having a bad day.
beats.spokenText: [haughty, flustered] Eyes off, commoner. My magic is just having a bad day.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: It's not a bad day. You're aiming at your family's approval. Aim at something you want to protect.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, intense] It's not a bad day. You're aiming at your family's approval. Aim at something you want to protect.

beats.speaker: NOELLE
beats.captionText: Don't get the wrong idea. I didn't ask a commoner for advice.
beats.spokenText: [sharp, defensive] Don't get the wrong idea. I didn't ask a commoner for advice.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: But her fingers close anyway. She thinks of nothing she has to win, only of what she'd stand in front of. And the water rises in her bare palm. No wand. Round, and perfectly still.
beats.spokenText: [hushed] But her fingers close anyway. She thinks of nothing she has to win, only of what she'd stand in front of. And the water rises in her bare palm. No wand. Round, and perfectly still.

beats.speaker: NOELLE
beats.captionText: It's holding. It's actually holding. It's listening to me.
beats.spokenText: [breathless] It's holding. It's actually holding. It's listening to me.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Yeah. That one's all yours.
beats.spokenText: Yeah. That one's all yours.

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.captionText: Listen, brat. The Black Bulls aren't exactly—
beats.spokenText: Listen, brat. The Black Bulls aren't exactly—

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Black Bulls. I'm in. Sign me up.
beats.spokenText: Black Bulls. I'm in. Sign me up.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Across the arena, Yuno signs with the Golden Dawn. His wind moves before he breathes in. That's what years of chasing one boy will do.
beats.spokenText: Across the arena, Yoo-no signs with the Golden Dawn. His wind moves before he breathes in. That's what years of chasing one boy will do.

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.captionText: Don't fall behind, Asta.
beats.spokenText: Don't fall behind, Asta.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Don't trip, Yuno.
beats.spokenText: Don't trip, Yoo-no.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: On the arena floor, Asta closes his eyes. The captains' box becomes a map of heartbeats.
beats.spokenText: On the arena floor, Asta closes his eyes. The captains' box becomes a map of heartbeats.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He knows exactly where to look. William Vangeance sits very still, and inside him there are two Ki. Two lives. One body.
beats.spokenText: He knows exactly where to look. William Van-jance sits very still, and inside him there are two Key. Two lives. One body.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: But this time, someone feels it back. Behind William's calm eyes, Patolli turns, slow as a blade, toward the boy who is looking.
beats.spokenText: [chilling] But this time, someone feels it back. Behind William's calm eyes, Pah-toh-lee turns, slow as a blade, toward the boy who is looking.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Above them all, Wizard King Julius Novachrono tilts his head. He's watching the boy.
beats.spokenText: Above them all, Wizard King Joo-lee-us Noh-vah-kroh-no tilts his head. He's watching the boy.

beats.speaker: JULIUS
beats.captionText: Oh? This boy's time doesn't move like ours. Someone has wound it back. How interesting.
beats.spokenText: [soft, delighted] Oh? This boy's time doesn't move like ours. Someone has wound it back. How interesting.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: That night, on the road to the Black Bulls' hideout, the air above the trees folds open like torn cloth. White-robed mages step out, one after another. The Eye of the Midnight Sun. Months early.
beats.spokenText: [low, ominous] That night, on the road to the Black Bulls' hideout, the air above the trees folds open like torn cloth. White-robed mages step out, one after another. The Eye of the Midnight Sun. Months early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: None of this happened in his first life. Asta stops walking. The future he memorized has just stopped being true.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, stunned] None of this happened in his first life. Asta stops walking. The future he memorized has just stopped being true.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: In Part Two, the Eye of the Midnight Sun comes for the one boy who knows exactly how this story ends.
beats.spokenText: In Part Two, the Eye of the Midnight Sun comes for the one boy who knows exactly how this story ends.

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.captionText: Wind's changed. Fine. Then I'll learn to read it all over again.
beats.spokenText: [quiet, determined] Wind's changed. Fine. Then I'll learn to read it all over again.
